top_signals.title: US Futures Gain With Microsoft Outage, Producer Prices in Focus
top_signals.summary: US equity futures were little changed early Friday as investors weigh a global software outage at Microsoft Corp., more news on the direction of the AI trade, and the next barometer for US inflation.
